note.zh-TW: IFRS 導入前的台灣用語；照教材顯示並加「舊稱」標記，現行名稱列為別名。
note.en: The pre-IFRS Taiwanese term; shown as the course writes it with an old-name marker, and the current name is kept as an alias.

definition.zh-TW: 模板裡放機器設備等長期使用實體資產的分組標題，不可入帳。現行報表稱為不動產、廠房及設備。
definition.en: The template group heading for equipment and other physical assets held for long-term use; it cannot be posted to. Current statements say property, plant and equipment.
